name: @leetcamp/api
//scripts: `dev` uses --conditions=development so tsx resolves the workspace packages to
their TypeScript sources: no build step between editing the domain and seeing
the change. `start` MUST NOT carry that flag — inside the runtime image it
would point at src/*.ts files that were never shipped, and the container dies
`typecheck` and `build` both run db:generate first: the generated client is a
build artefact, git-ignored, and tsc cannot compile without it on a clean clone.
`build` ends with copy-prisma-client.mjs — see that script for why.

scripts.build: pnpm db:generate && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-prisma-client.mjs

//dependencies: Conservative ^ ranges. Resolve the real versions with Context7 MCP before

lines below — they resolve to two distinct workspace packages. School
hexagonal collapses both placeholders to the same @leetcamp/core value, so
scaffold.mjs must drop the @leetcamp/application line for that school —
